title: .Net Backend Team Lead
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology‑driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best‑in‑class telecom platform, including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in‑house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital‑first businesses, including neo‑banks, global fast‑moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally , enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs Hakan Koçand Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications . We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world‑class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

Position Overview

We are looking for a talented and experienced engineering leader to join our team and lead the implementation, scaling, and growth of multiple platform software solutions that deliver complex features to business verticals. As a Team Lead, you will act as both a technical authority and an engineering manager, responsible for guiding technical direction, ensuring delivery, and fostering team growth. This role blends technical expertise, leadership, and strategic vision to build scalable and reliable solutions.

You'll be part of an international environment, working closely with cross‑functional teams to shape and evolve our platform and digital experiences. We value teamwork and embrace a culture of ownership—our engineers are both autonomous and accountable for their deliverables. We are deeply customer‑focused and committed to building software that creates real value for our users and the business.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key Responsibilities
  • Interpret business needs from customers, stakeholders, and product managers, translating them into clear and actionable development tasks
  • Design, document, and communicate scalable solution architectures, assessing technical impact, effort, and resource requirements
  • Own the technical knowledge over the full domain and ensure effective system integration
  • Design and implement scalable backend services, leveraging cloud technologies such as AWS
  • Drive engineering maturity, fostering customer‑centric design and architecture practices at scale
  • Promote and enforce best practices in coding standards, software quality, code reviews, and system architecture
  • Oversee CI/CD pipelines, ensuring smooth, reliable deployments and high system stability
  • Manage project timelines, prioritize team activities, and ensure predictable, on‑time delivery of features and solutions
  • Lead by example, mentor engineers, and provide guidance to support their technical growth and career development
  • Ensure strong team engagement, motivation, continuous learning, and a collaborative engineering culture
  • Participate in recruitment efforts and uphold high standards for technical excellence across the team
Requirements Must Have
  • Proven technical leadership and people management experience (team lead or similar)
  • Strong emotional intelligence, communication, and cross‑functional collaboration skills
  • Ability to balance short‑term delivery pressure with long‑term technical vision
  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously
  • Experience developing and operating scalable, distributed systems
  • Strong software architecture skills, including microservices, system design, and performance optimization
  • Deep understanding of concurrency, asynchronous workflows, and performance best practices
  • Commitment to clean code, testing, quality, and full software lifecycle ownership
  • Proficiency in .NET
  • Cloud experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar platforms
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps principles
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Expertise in RESTful API design and implementation
  • Solid knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases
  • Familiarity with event‑driven systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Knowledge of networking fundamentals and security best practices
  • Experience with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, etc.)
Nice to Have
  • Experience with Go is a plus
  • Experience in Telecom is a plus
Benefits
  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave — 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!
Why 1GLOBAL?
  • Growth Opportunities : Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year‑on‑year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure : Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team : From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly be exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment : Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development : Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field
  • International Experience : Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture : Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude : Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

A Hydro Energia atua como uma comercializadora independente de energia elétrica, oferecendo serviços como gestão e otimização de portfólio de energia, consultoria regulatória e comercial, além de operações estruturadas no mercado de energia. No Brasil, a empresa tem escritórios em Belém e no Rio de Janeiro e é uma das maiores operadoras no mercado livre de energia no Norte do país. Aqui fazemos mais do que conectar energia: conectamos ideias, inovação e sustentabilidade. Nosso compromisso é construir um futuro energético mais eficiente, sustentável e inteligente.

O que oferecemos a você
  • Salário competitivo com o Mercado de Energia, com um pacote abrangente de benefícios, garantindo que você seja recompensado pelas suas contribuições.
  • A oportunidade de se juntar a equipes diversas em uma empresa líder global em alumínio e energias renováveis que está mudando o jogo do alumínio.
  • Um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, criativo, com projetos globais e ambições sustentáveis.
  • Oportunidade de moldar a função e crescer na carreira por meio do desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal.
  • Você será parte de um negócio para o futuro juntando-se a nós em uma jornada transformadora.
O que você fará
  • Liderar tecnicamente e executar o processo de previsão de preços de energia de curto e médio prazo, promovendo sua evolução contínua e garantindo consistência metodológica, robustez analítica e qualidade dos resultados.
  • Atuar como assessor técnico da mesa de trading, fornecendo análises, cenários e recomendações para posicionamento e mitigação de riscos.
  • Acompanhar e participar ativamente de fóruns, reuniões e grupos de trabalho do Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS) e da Câmara de Comercialização de Energia Elétrica (CCEE) relacionados à formação do Preço de Liquidação das Diferenças (PLD), bem como monitorar regulação, notas técnicas e consultas públicas sobre o tema, antecipando potenciais impactos nos preços e nas estratégias comerciais da empresa.
  • Desenvolver, estruturar e evoluir processos automatizados, códigos e modelos internos associados à previsão de preços de curto e médio prazo (modelos principais e/ou satélites), assegurando atualização metodológica contínua, rastreabilidade e eficiência computacional.
  • Planejar e conduzir estudos complexos sobre formação de preços, avaliação de riscos e drivers estruturais do setor elétrico (expansão da geração, limites de transmissão, projeção de demanda, entre outros).
O que fará você ter sucesso? Formação Acadêmica
  • Superior completo em Engenharia, Economia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável Mestrado em Otimização, Planejamento Energético, Modelagem Quantitativa ou áreas correlatas.
Conhecimentos e Habilidades
  • Experiência no mercado de energia elétrica.
  • Conhecimento dos modelos computacionais Newave, Decomp e Dessem.
  • Inglês avançado para conversação, escrita e leitura.
  • Pacote Office avançado.
  • Nível avançado em programação (necessário conhecimento de Python).
  • Nível avançado em ferramentas de Business Intelligence (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Desejável conhecimento de técnicas avançadas de estatística e machine learning.
Perfil
  • Liderança técnica em modelagem e previsão de preços de energia.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e visão quantitativa.
  • Pensamento crítico para avaliação de modelos e premissas regulatórias.
  • Orientação a risco e suporte estratégico à mesa de trading.
  • Domínio de programação e automação de modelos (Python & BI).
  • Conhecimento aprofundado do setor elétrico e formação de PLD.

A Hydro valoriza diversas habilidades e perspectivas entre os empregados. Encorajamos todas as pessoas qualificadas a se inscreverem. Os perfis aderentes serão considerados independentemente de raça, religião, nacionalidade, etnia, idade, gênero, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência. Nós nos esforçamos para oferecer oportunidades iguais para que todos possam contribuir e ter sucesso conosco.

Atuação na Norsk Hydro (Rio de Janeiro/RJ ou Belém/PA), podendo ser uma localidade flexível.

title: OPERADOR ARMAZENAGEM II
description:
Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição do emprego
  • Monitorar a entrada e saída de grãos dos secadores, através da análise de umidade para checar a temperatura necessária para a secagem dos grãos;
  • Acompanhar a temperatura dos secadores, e realizar abastecimento das fornalhas com lenha, quando necessário;
  • Facilitar o fluxo na descarga de caminhões, regulando a carga de abastecimento dos secadores de acordo com os parâmetros das variáveis acima citadas;
  • Monitorar a temperatura do produto estocado nos armazéns, gerar relatórios de termometria para analisar a necessidade de forçar alteração ou remoção dos grãos e tomar as devidas providências, informando o Supervisor de Armazenagem e Gerência quando necessário;
  • Monitorar o processo de limpeza da soja, regulando cargas nas peneiras, limpeza nas telas do equipamento;
  • Acompanhar o abastecimento dos armazéns, controlar os pontos de entrada e retirada de produto, para evitar derramamentos e remoção de pontos indevidos;
  • Manter a área de trabalho limpa e organizada, seguindo as Instruções de Trabalho, cronogramas de limpeza e demais orientações dos programas implantados na unidade;
  • Trabalhar de acordo com as Políticas e Normas da Cia, atendendo as determinações do Sistema de Gestão SHE (Segurança, Saúde e Meio Ambiente), Procedimentos Locais e Divisionais e realizar inspeções de segurança no próprio setor, com o objetivo de evitar a ocorrência de acidentes;
Qualificações
  • Disponibilidade de horário.
Informações Adicionais

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa.

Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

title: Data Architect
description:
At R2, we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society. Small and medium businesses (SMBs) make up over 90% of companies in Latin America, yet they face a trillion-dollar credit gap. Our mission is to unlock SMBs’ potential by providing financial solutions that are tailored to their needs. We are reimagining the financial infrastructure of Latin America, where SMBs financial needs are satisfied without ever having to go to a bank.

R2 enables platforms in Latin America to embed financial services that SMBs can then leverage (starting with revenue-based financing). We are a tight-knit team coming from organizations such as Google, Amazon, Nubank, Uber, Capital One, Mercado Libre, Globant, and J.P. Morgan. We are entering a new phase of growth following a strategic investment from Ant International, focused on rapidly expanding our partner footprint, strengthening our credit and underwriting capabilities, and scaling our operations across multiple markets.

As a Data Architect, you will operate as a lead individual contributor, owning complex data systems end-to-end and shaping the data engineering strategy of the company. This role requires strong system-level thinking, deep technical expertise, and the ability to influence direction, standards, and execution across teams—without direct people management accountability.

You will act as a technical driver, setting best practices, mentoring others, and ensuring data platforms scale reliably with the business.

What you will do
  • Architect, build, and own scalable ELT pipelines, data orchestration, and the enterprise data warehouse.
  • Lead requirements analysis and solution design, ensuring an end-to-end view of the data ecosystem.
  • Own the operation, reliability, and monitoring of production data pipelines.
  • Drive data projects from ideation through execution, acting as the primary owner and decision-maker.
  • Design and implement standardized, analytics-ready data models that support reporting, experimentation, and advanced analytics.
  • Build reusable ingestion and integration frameworks for internal systems and external partners.
  • Establish and continuously improve automation, orchestration, and observability across data workflows.
  • Define and enforce data engineering standards, including modeling, testing, documentation, and deployment.
  • Integrate AI-enabled tooling and agents where appropriate to improve productivity and data operations.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation for architecture, pipelines, and processes.
  • Act as a technical mentor for Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers.
  • Provide guidance on design decisions, code quality, and architectural trade-offs.
  • Lead by influence—reviewing designs, unblocking teams, and driving alignment.
  • Support the maturation of the data team by modeling best practices and ownership mindset.
Who you are
  • 5–8+ years of experience in Data Engineering or closely related roles.
  • Proven ability to design complex, production-grade data systems.
  • Strong software engineering background, with deep expertise in Python.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and dimensional / analytical data modeling.
  • Hands‑on experience with ELT patterns and tools such as Airbyte, Fivetran, or similar.
  • Strong experience with data orchestration platforms, preferably Airflow.
  • Deep experience with dbt for transformations and modeling.
  • Comfortable owning systems in production, including monitoring, alerting, and incident response.
  • Strong experience collaborating with Analytics, Product, Risk, and ML teams.
  • Able to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Highly autonomous, proactive, and accountable.
Tech Stack (Preferred)
  • Snowflake (strong preference)
  • Airflow
  • dbt
  • AWS

Experience with Snowflake-based architectures is a key differentiator. Profiles primarily centered on Databricks without Snowflake exposure may not be a strong fit.

Bonus Points
  • Experience integrating AI/ML tooling or agents into data workflows.
  • Experience designing self-serve analytics platforms.
  • Experience with fintech, lending, or risk-related data models.
  • Experience building multi-region or multi-entity data platforms.

Location: São Paulo, BR, Santiago CL, Buenos Aires Ar or Bogotá CO.

We are looking for a hands‑on Head of User Acquisition to join our international team! Someone who is a builder combining technical expertise, strong ownership and curiosity to grow our acquisition efforts beyond our existing ASO team and our recent UA efforts.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will take full ownership of our App’s global acquisition strategies for our portfolio of iOS and Android apps and games, driving ambitious growth targets.

This is a crucial position for a hands‑on leader who excels at scaling user bases and achieving significant ROI. It’s perfect for a growth‑minded doer who loves acting fast, testing bold ideas, and playing a ‘player‑coach’ role in the first year: executing campaigns today while building the team for tomorrow.

  • Develop, own, and execute comprehensive global acquisition strategies for our portfolio of iOS and Android apps and games, aligning with ambitious growth targets.
  • Oversee, optimize, and scale paid acquisition campaigns across various channels, including social, influencer, direct ad networks, and other emerging channels.
  • Lead, mentor, and expand a team of acquisition specialists, fostering a culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and data‑driven decision‑making.
  • Guiding the team, champion a rigorous A/B testing framework across all acquisition channels to drive performance and uncover growth opportunities.
  • Set and ensure tracking of key performance indicators, including CPI, CPA, ROAS, LTV, and retention rates to guide strategic adjustments.
  • Manage and allocate the acquisition budget at a macro level, ensuring optimal resource distribution across titles, geos, and channels.
  • App Store Optimization efforts, including keyword research and store listing optimization, to improve visibility, conversion rates, and organic growth across all titles.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Monetization teams to align acquisition strategies with overall business objectives, product roadmaps, and cohesive user experiences.
  • Stay up‑to‑date with industry trends, platform changes, algorithmic updates, and competitor strategies to reach a competitive edge.
Who You Are
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field; a Master’s degree is a plus.
  • 4+ years of experience in mobile user acquisition, with a significant portion in a leadership or senior management role, preferably within the mobile app publishing industry.
  • Demonstrable track record of successfully scaling user bases and achieving significant ROI on acquisition spend.
  • Expertise in ASO tools and best practices.
  • In‑depth knowledge and hands‑on experience with various paid acquisition platforms (e.g., Apple Search Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads) and ad networks.
  • Proficiency with mobile attribution and analytics platforms (e.g., Adjust, AppsFlyer, Branch).
  • Strong understanding of influencer marketing strategies and experience managing influencer campaigns.
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable strategies.
  • Experience in building, leading, and mentoring a high‑performing team.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Business Communication & Influence

Who you are

title: Jeugdzorgwerker B (ambulant begeleider) jonge meiden en moeders
description:
Werk je graag met jonge meiden en jonge moeders die in hun leven tegen moeilijkheden zijn aangelopen en niet meer thuis kunnen wonen? Wil je hen begeleiden richting zelfstandigheid? En sta je stevig in je schoenen? Kom dan werken bij Timon. Bekijk de vacature jeugdzorgwerker B bij Talita/Ziva in Houten.

Talita/Ziva in Houten is een verblijf- en behandelvoorziening voor jonge moeders én voor meiden met sekse-specifieke problematiek vanaf 15 jaar. Het gaat om een kleinschalige, 24-uurs woonvoorziening. De jongeren verblijven hier gemiddeld anderhalf jaar.

Geduld, doorzettingsvermogen en daadkracht

Een stabiele en veilige omgeving is niet altijd vanzelfsprekend. Als jeugdzorgwerker B begeleid je jonge moeders en meiden die door omstandigheden (tijdelijk) niet meer thuis kunnen wonen. Je hebt hier te maken met onder meer angst- en stemmingsstoornissen, traumagerelateerde en hechtingsproblematiek, agressie, drugsgebruik en specifieke meidenproblematiek. Aan jou de uitdaging hen te begeleiden, op allerlei levensgebieden. Dat vraagt van jou als jeugdzorgwerker B om geduld, doorzettingsvermogen en daadkracht. Omdat er altijd iets kan gebeuren, ben je flexibel en kan je snel schakelen. Als de situatie daarom vraagt, neem je het initiatief en je behoudt het overzicht.

Jouw werk doet ertoe

Als jeugdzorgwerker B ben je mentor van een aantal jongeren. Je begeleidt hen 1-op-1. Je motiveert en ondersteunt de jongere in het behalen van haar doelen. Je krijgt energie van het individuele groeiproces van de jongere en elk stapje zie je als winst. Je houdt de veiligheid in het oog en je werkt aan het creëren van een stabiele omgeving. Vanuit je hart en je deskundigheid begeleid je jongeren naar zelfstandigheid. Daarbij betrek je ook zowel het privé netwerk als het professioneel netwerk rondom de jongere, zoals ketenpartners als bijvoorbeeld de Jeugdbescherming of het sociaal team. Kortom, jouw werk doet ertoe!

Het begeleiden van de cliënten doe je in samenwerking met het team van groepsbegeleiders op de locatie. De gedragswetenschapper en teammanager zijn op de achtergrond betrokken en voorzien je van advies en ondersteuning. Bij het begeleiden van de jonge moeders werk je ook samen met de Ouder- en Kind Behandelaren. Binnen deze functie kun je ook te maken krijgen met groepsdynamica.

Dit ga je doen
  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het begeleiden van het traject van de jongeren
  • Je stelt samen met de jongere doelen op en legt die vast in het hulpverleningsplan
  • In afstemming met de gedragswetenschapper en vanuit verschillende methodieken, geef jij de begeleiding vorm. Je zet in wat op dat moment nodig is in de situatie.
  • Je bent contactpersoon voor én tussen ouders/(gezins)voogden, scholen en andere betrokken instanties

Je werkt in principe volgens een vast rooster. Af en toe vragen we van jou flexibiliteit om een andere dienst te draaien. Het rooster bestaat uit vroege diensten, late diensten en één keer in de maand weekenddiensten.

Dit vragen we van je
  • Een relevant HBO-diploma (bijvoorbeeld Social Work of Pedagogiek)
  • Registratie in het beroepsregister SKJ (Stichting Kwaliteitskader Jeugd)
  • Minimaal twee jaar ervaring in de (jeugd)zorg
  • Je hebt kennis van behandelmethodes (zoals Contextueel Werken, Wrap Around Care, Beschermjassen en SOS) en wilt hierin leren en groeien
Dit bieden wij

Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg (schaal 9) van € 3191,69 tot € 4766,96, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring
  • Een jaarcontract. Functioneer je goed? Dan zetten we dit contract om in een vast dienstverband
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris
  • Een eigen coach die jou helpt met je persoonlijke doelstellingen en ontwikkeling
  • Binnen Timon krijg je een uitgebreid inwerktraject waarin we je koppelen aan een buddy. Daarnaast volg je diverse trainingen en opleidingen gericht op jouw functie, zoals bijvoorbeeld Hechting Jonge kind.
Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met ruim 800 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland.

Jij @ Timon?

Denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij je past? Solliciteer dan op de vacature voor jeugdzorgwerker B. Voor vragen over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met onze recruiters via

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Senior Data Scientist – Credix • Araçatuba, São Paulo, Brazil

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.

Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.

Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Risk & Collections team. You’ll operate with high autonomy, own critical problem areas, and deliver value that moves the needle - from credit performance to capital efficiency. This isn’t a research role. You’ll work side-by-side with engineering, product, and operations to deploy models, run experiments, and improve the core systems that decide: Who gets funded, how and when we collect, and where we allocate risk capital.

Your focus
  • Model borrower risk: Build and refine probability-of-default (PD) and loss-given-default (LGD) models to inform underwriting and exposure sizing.
  • Detect and prevent fraud: Develop fraud signals and real-time scoring logic to flag suspicious behaviors – from application spoofing to behavioral anomalies post-purchase.
  • Prioritize recovery actions: Predict repayment propensity and optimize collections targeting – so we know who to contact, how, and when.
  • Design experiments: Run tests across channels, messages, and strategies – not for learning’s sake, but to improve recovery, reduce loss, or increase throughput.
  • Deploy your work: Work closely with engineering to embed models and logic into our core credit and collections systems.
  • Create leverage: Equip the Risk, Credit, and Ops teams with tools, insights, and automation that scale smarter decisions.
What We’re Looking For
  • 5+ years of experience applying data science to business-critical problems.
  • Strong command of SQL, Python, and the practical use of ML techniques (e.g., classification, uplift modeling, time series, or embeddings).
  • Experience deploying models in production – including versioning, validation, and post‑deployment monitoring.
  • Comfort working autonomously with a high bar for quality and impact.
  • Experience working with product or engineering teams to embed model logic into live systems.
  • Solid understanding of business economics – marginal value, yield, CAC/LTV, or credit-related KPIs.
Nice to Have
  • Background in lending, collections, or credit analytics.
  • Experience with experimentation frameworks or causal inference.
  • Exposure to NLP or classification techniques (e.g., message quality prediction).
Languages
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and verbal).
What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in‑office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in São Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

What else we offer
  • A culture of learning and experimentation – where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies.
  • Competitive salary package – your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well‑rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan – be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays – enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate.
  • Off‑sites – awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off‑sites.

Senior iOS Software Engineer About The Role

We are seeking a Senior iOS Software Engineer to join our Mobile Engineering organization as a key individual contributor. In this role, you will take on complex technical challenges, influence platform architecture, and support the long‑term evolution of our mobile application ecosystem. You will collaborate closely with Principal Engineers and Architects to define and implement the mobile technology roadmap, ensuring scalability, performance, and engineering excellence. This role suits a highly autonomous engineer who thrives in fast‑paced, collaborative environments and who enjoys mentoring junior developers while delivering high‑impact solutions.

About The Team

Our Mobile Engineering Team is focused on designing and delivering innovative mobile experiences for large‑scale consumer audiences. We leverage the latest iOS technologies and industry best practices to create engaging, performant, and user‑centered applications.

Work Model

Fully Remote , exclusively for candidates residing in Argentina , as employment and payroll operations are managed from Argentina.

Your Day-to-Day (Responsibilities)
  • Architect, design, and develop intuitive and elegantly crafted iOS applications.
  • Develop tools, frameworks, and processes that enhance the mobile engineering pipeline.
  • Collaborate with Product, Design, Delivery, Editorial, and Engineering teams to ship high‑quality mobile experiences.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, conduct root cause analysis, and support incident resolution.
  • Maintain and evolve existing mobile systems within a large digital ecosystem.
  • Mentor junior developers and support continuous learning within the team.
  • Ensure engineering solutions adhere to established architectural, security, and coding standards, including monitoring, logging, testing, and service enablement.
Qualifications
  • BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong foundation in programming fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.
  • Experience designing new applications and enhancing existing codebases.
  • Deep knowledge of native iOS development using Swift, Objective‑C, SwiftUI, and iOS frameworks.
  • Proven experience architecting scalable, performant, and secure mobile applications.
  • Hands‑on experience with mobile DevOps and CI/CD tooling (preferably Git and Bitrise), including automation, code signing, and testing.
  • Strong communication skills for effective collaboration across technical and non‑technical teams.
  • Experience building adaptable software architectures that support evolving business requirements.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS.
  • General understanding of database technologies (SQL, NoSQL, GraphDB, etc.).

title: Senior Manager, Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) Core Consulting
description:
Company Description

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters — to you, to your community, and to the world.

Progress starts with you.

Team Description

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.

Job Description

The VCA team is looking for a Senior Manager to join our consulting practice and play a role in developing high impact projects for Visa clients in Brazil. This person will develop initiatives to promote sustainable and profitable growth, thereby ensuring that Visa is both, the preferred brand and unique business partner.

Potential engagements could include product development, program launch, customer acquisition, customer and commercial life cycle optimization, retention enhancement, benchmark analysis, profitability enhancement.

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Proactively engage with Visa teams in regular strategic and planning discussions, cultivate and manage a pipeline of work with Merchants, Issuers and Digital Banks.
  • Leads consulting initiatives and contributes to closing engagement by identifying potential opportunities.
  • Develop frameworks, approaches, solutions, and recommendations that effectively and efficiently address the most impactful opportunities and challenges.
  • Build solutions and actionable insights that will help clients to grow their portfolios and cardholder engagement with the issuer.
  • Partner with peers in other functional areas (e.g., sales, solutions, client service, marketing, sales, risk, innovation) and across global regional teams to execute projects in ways that leverage the breadth and depth of Visa resources.
  • Produce insights, analyses, and recommendations to improve client performance, boost growth, drive understanding of client issues and provide strategic guidance for client priorities across the verticals and segments.
  • Ability to effectively manipulate and analyze large data sets (industry and Visa) to determine meanings insights and recommendations for the clients.
  • Build new scalable solutions, toolkits, best practice documents and consulting approach that can be applied across VCA practice.

Incumbents applying for the role should be self-motivated, highly energized, detail-oriented individuals who will deliver strategic thought leadership, problem diagnostics and high impact solutions to clients support the growth and performance. Candidates must be able to develop enduring, strategic relationships with internal and external clients and across the Visa organization. This is an individual contributor role, reporting into a VCA Brazilian Director.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

Qualifications
  • 6+ years of work experience with a bachelor degree and MBA will be a competitive differentiation
  • Bi-lingual (English and Portuguese)
  • Relevant experience at large management consulting firm or at financial institutions
  • Experience working with financial indicators to measure business performance. Significant focus on impacting ROI
  • Strong analytical skills, with demonstrated intellectual and analytical rigor
  • Self-motivated, results oriented individual with the ability to handle numerous projects concurrently
  • Knowledge and understanding of banking operations and or payment schemes, including products and services, business systems and processes, marketing initiatives and card acquiring experience
  • Excellent communication, story-telling and presentation skills
  • Technology mindset, curious, up to date with digital trends and applications
Additional Information

Visa is an EEO Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Job Title:

Google Cloud Engagement Manager

Location:

Offshore Remote (LATAM) – São Paulo, Brazil

Duration:

6 Months (Extendable)

Rate:

USD 28–3o/hr

Employment Type:

Contract (No Independent Contractors)

Duties:

This position is responsible for providing leadership, management and strategy for the sell with/go-to-market engagement and all joint activities with GCP. The Engagement manager will have a myriad of different responsibilities to ensure leverage and consistent engagement with GCP to drive customer engagements, qualified pipeline and cloud bookings that meet and exceed quota and expectations. The Engagement Manager will be part of the team that coordinates Palo Alto Networks sales activities and will be a central conduit for engagement management between the Palo Alto Network’s sales organization and GCP. He will report to the director for Service Providers but will have several dotted line coordination requirements for consistent communication and engagement with Business Development, Marketing, Channels, Inside Sales and Product Marketing/Development. This position will be knowledge expert on all aspects of GCP and will be asked to present at QBRs, executive meetings, training and events.

The GCP Engagement Manager is regarded to be highly strategic to the company and the Public Cloud initiative in regards to strategy, influence and execution. The Engagement manager is required to contribute to the larger Palo Alto Network’s Public Cloud strategy outside of their day-to-day activities and will be called upon for their subject matter expertise in training, QBRs, enablement, and other engagement activities. It is expected that he chases consistent interaction and engagement with customers, strategic vendors, channel partners and other third parties in support of the “sell with” activities with GCP. The Engagement manager will demonstrate a deep understanding of GCP go-to-market strategies including but not limited to co-selling, strategic planning and goal setting, channel programs, marketing campaigns and programs, strategic events and funnel management.

  • Manage joint sell with and go to market activities with GCP
  • Track all opportunities, pipeline and bookings and provide forecasts and funnel management reports
  • Facilitate co-selling opportunities, account mapping and other sales engagements between Palo Alto Network’s field sales and the GCP sales teams
  • Support Palo Alto Network’s field sales organization on engagement management with GCP
  • Assist with providing content for Google Cloud training curriculum and sales enablement
  • Coordinate activities and have involvement with the Public Cloud virtual team of Business Development, Marketing, Product Management, Channels and Sales as part of cloud strategy
  • Develop annual strategic plan and performance goals for assigned GCPr
  • Provide support and coordination for channel activity with assigned Cloud Provider
  • Understand and articulate Google Cloud strategic initiatives and gain a deep understanding of the activities, roadmap and vision of the Cloud Provider
  • Provide an escalation point for pre-sales and post sales issues for any activity with the GCP
  • Build and maintain relationships with key personnel in GCP to solidify Palo Alto Network’s standing and awareness within the provider and to assist in the development of key relationships with the extended Palo Alto Network’s cloud team and executives
  • Direct engagement and partner relationships are a critical part of this role
  • Help provide insight in the support of Google Cloud events and attend/participate in the events
  • Provide support in the form of expertise and training for Palo Alto Network’s field sales enablement
Skills:
  • BA, BS (or equivalent work experience), MBA preferred
  • 5+ Years’ experience in Sales – Account or Channel Management
  • Public Cloud experience preferred
  • Channel experience including selling with or managing channel partners is preferred
  • Channel Program experience is a plus
  • Demonstrated history of managing quota bearing sales or channel teams
  • Industry knowledge of security product market trends and directional awareness of Palo Alto Network’s roadmap and technology development efforts.
  • The role calls for knowledge of competitive security products.
  • Knowledge of how to deliver comprehensive security solutions to PAN’s customer base and maintains a general understanding of competitive selling strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a virtual and matrix environment
  • 25% Travel with ability to travel internationally
  • Strong communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills
  • “Whatever it takes” attitude and motivation to do whatever necessary to assist in winning business
Education:

BA, BS (or equivalent work experience), MBA preferred

Rattaché hiérarchiquement au Chef du Département, vous êtes responsable du périmètre couvrant les applications du domaine scientifique et industriel. Cela couvre la majeure partie des applications permettant la gestion du cycle de vie des données (acquisition, traitement, stockage, analyse, simulation, visualisation, diffusion, archivage) des données scientifiques, dont les données environnementales (piézométrie, météo, observation et caractérisation faune et flore, propriétés géologiques, géochimiques et géomécaniques…)

Vous portez la responsabilité de l’engagement de service du département vis-à-vis de ces métiers, depuis les réflexions amont jusqu’à l’exploitation du SI, en passant par le bon aboutissement des projets.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec :

  • Les responsables des entités métiers dont vous êtes l’interlocuteur privilégié, notamment la Direction industrielle et du Grand Est (DIGE) dont le Centre de Meuse/Haute-Marne (site du futur centre de Cigéo), les différents centres en exploitation de l’Andra et la Direction scientifique et technique (DISTEC),
  • L’Architecte d’entreprise, qui anime et coordonne les partenaires numériques et est garant de la cohérence applicative globale,

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose / ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: Principal Development Architect - SAP Business Data Cloud Technology Office
description:
Principal Development Architect - SAP Business Data Cloud Technology Office

At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. How? We focus every day on building the foundation for tomorrow and creating a workplace that embraces differences, values flexibility, and is aligned to our purpose-driven and future-focused work. We offer a highly collaborative, caring team environment with a strong focus on learning and development, recognition for your individual contributions, and a variety of benefit options for you to choosefrom.

Summary

We’re looking for a visionary Principal Development Architect to join SAP’s Business Data Cloud Technology Office — a central team driving the future of SAP’s data management strategy. This is a high-impact, cross-organizational role where you’ll help define the architecture of our next-generation cloud services, influencing product direction across SAP and shaping how data powers intelligent enterprise solutions.
You’ll work alongside some of the most experienced architects in the industry, helping to build the backbone of SAP’s platform and product portfolio.

What you’ll do
  • In addition to defining the general and future architecture for the BDC&I cloud platform & service, you will get to work first‑hand with leading edge technologies.
  • You will directly collaborate with internal stakeholders and business partners to understand scenarios and needs, align concepts & ideas within the unit and across SAP.
  • With this you will contribute to pave the way for the development teams to adopt the concepts by also creating and developing required organizational and process networks within the development in conjunction with product management.
  • Since you will be acting as a spearhead of our development organization you will embed in and also have the task to drive and align architecture topics across the entire company along the central architecture alignment board of SAP.
  • You will work in a diverse & distributed team, driving architecture and technology strategy into actual project work and execution, together with the SAP BDC&I and LoB development organizations.
  • As the success of the new Business Data Cloud Service heavily relays on the delivery of Data Products by the LoBs, you will also contribute to foster LoB adoption.
  • This opportunity is an ideal role for an enterprise customer thinking, very focused and ambitious individual who can work in a highly flexible environment with some of the most skilled and experienced professionals in the industry.
What you bring
  • Desire to work on the leading edge of cloud‑based platform, analytics, data management and Data Integration technologies including the emerging Lakehouse architectures / data fabric topics
  • To support our Lakehouse architecture, you ideally demonstrate your experience in Spark and Object Store technologies
  • Ideally deeper knowledge and experience in LoB specific data platform development projects
  • Track record of quickly adapting to new environments, balancing tradeoffs, and demonstrating flexible, pragmatic, and long‑term thinking
  • Leverage AI technologies for data management and analyticsas well as contribution to technical building blocks which enable SAPs global Business AI
  • Profound experience in data integration technologies (SAP data, non‑SAP data, data lakes) and enterprise applications
  • Established record of accomplishments as an architect with analytics and data management engineering teams
  • Ideally deeper knowledge and a track record in leading data warehousing projects as an architect and leader
  • Practical experience with operating Cloud‑scale services in production and working on topics around scaling and resilience
  • Excellent presentation and public speaking skills
  • Excellent communication skills, proven inter‑personal and leadership skills to drive product‑ & technology‑related discussions internally & externally
  • Ability to communicate and influence effectively at C suite and above
  • Self‑motivation with a positive can‑do attitude, eagerness, and ability to work quickly
  • Great work experience in large scale software development & architectural tasks
  • Profound knowledge in the cloud environment
  • Strong customer and partner orientation
  • Degree in Computer science or related fields
Meet your SAP BDC&I Development team

The SAP BDC&I Development organization is tasked with bringing the powerful capabilities of SAP HANA Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud and different application specific Data Platform approaches together in a harmonized and seamlessly integrated way to harness the potential of the full information value chain - creating an entirely new cloud service and experiences that enable our customers to get the insights that they need to both understand the past and predict the future with full confidence based on data they can trust.

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end‑to‑end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose‑driven and future‑focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP,you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well‑being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better and more equitable world.

Grupo MAST – Cuidando de quem faz o futuro acontecer

Há mais de 20 anos, o Grupo MAST é referência nacional em Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho , sendo um ecossistema completo de saúde do trabalhador .

Nosso propósito é promover ambientes corporativos mais seguros, saudáveis e sustentáveis , com foco na prevenção, proteção e qualidade de vida dos colaboradores.

Resumo da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa referência técnica e funcional na plataforma SOC, responsável por garantir padronização, governança de dados, performance operacional e conformidade legal dos processos de Saúde Ocupacional e Segurança do Trabalho. Na prática, este papel atua como dono do processo dentro do sistema: parametriza, integra, monitora, audita, treina usuários e transforma necessidades do negócio em execução consistente dentro do SOC, com foco em escala, redução de retrabalho e controle de risco (operacional e regulatório).

Responsabilidades
  • Ser a referência interna da plataforma SOC, garantindo padronização, governança e evolução contínua dos processos de Saúde Ocupacional e SST dentro do sistema.
  • Parametrizar fluxos, regras de negócio e cadastros (empresas, unidades, cargos, funções, riscos, exames, agendas, documentos e demais entidades), assegurando consistência de ponta a ponta.
  • Definir e manter políticas de qualidade de dados, com padrões de cadastro, validações, rotinas de saneamento, auditorias periódicas e prevenção de recorrência de inconsistências.
  • Atuar como 2º/3º nível na sustentação, analisando incidentes e falhas complexas, executar diagnóstico de causa raiz, propor correções estruturais e monitorar estabilidade pós-implementação.
  • Operar e monitorar rotinas relacionadas ao eSocial SST: preparo de base, controle de status, tratamento de inconsistências, conciliação de retornos/recibos e rastreabilidade operacional.
  • Liderar integrações com RH/Folha/ERP e parceiros, apoiando mapeamento de campos, regras de validação, fluxos de importação/exportação, reconciliação e plano de testes.
  • Construir e manter documentação operacional e funcional com procedimentos
  • Treinar usuários e formar multiplicadores, garantindo adesão ao padrão e redução de dependência do suporte.
  • Definir e acompanhar indicadores de operação e conformidade
  • Apoiar a gestão de acessos e perfis, garantindo segregação adequada e aderência a boas práticas no tratamento de dados sensíveis.
  • Hard Skills
  • Experiência sólida e comprovada com a plataforma SOC em operação real (administração funcional, parametrização, sustentação e melhoria de processos).
  • Ciência de desenho e governança de processos (BPM), com mapeamento AS-IS/TO-BE, definição de controles, padronização, indicadores e rotinas de auditoria.
  • Vivência consistente com eSocial SST, com entendimento de cadastros críticos, dependências de dados, leitura e saneamento de inconsistências, acompanhamento de retornos e rastreabilidade.
  • Capacidade de conduzir testes funcionais (UAT), elaborar critérios de aceite, planejar rollout e assegurar estabilidade de mudanças em ambiente produtivo.
  • Experiência com integrações de dados (como analista funcional ou em parceria com TI) para especificação de requisitos, mapeamento de campos, validações, conciliação de cargas e troubleshooting de falhas.
  • Forte domínio de Excel/Google Sheets para análise operacional (tabelas dinâmicas, cruzamentos, validações, auditoria de cadastros e controles).
  • Desejável familiaridade com SQL e/ou ferramentas de BI para auditoria e monitoramento de indicadores.
  • Conhecimento prático de LGPD e boas práticas de segurança da informação aplicadas a dados de saúde (controle de acesso, minimização de dados, rastreabilidade e governança).
  • Soft Skills
  • Mentalidade de dono, com foco em padronização, estabilidade e escalabilidade.
  • Raciocínio analítico e orientação a causa raiz, com capacidade de transformar sintomas operacionais em correções estruturais.
  • Atenção a detalhes e rigor de qualidade: habilidade para manter consistência de dados e prevenir efeito cascata em rotinas críticas.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva com múltiplos públicos (Cliente, Operação, Segurança, RH, TI, fornecedores), traduzindo necessidades em regras e processos executáveis no sistema.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

title: Senior Product QA Engineer
description:
It’s an exciting time to join us! We’re entering new markets, developing new technologies, and moving step by step towards our goal of exciting the world. As our business grows, the number of exciting people initiatives grows with it, and we’re looking for a new colleague to partner with our team to bring these to life.

About The Role

Superbet is building the future of entertainment across Europe and Brazil - with millions of active users and over €1B in annual revenue.

Our Core Experience organization owns the surfaces that shape how players discover, play, and engage every day.

We’re now looking for a Senior Product QA Engineer to help us turn our homepage - one of the most strategic and high-traffic products in the company - into a world-class, high-performing experience.

The mission

Within the Explore Tribe , our goal is to deliver seamless, personalized, and reliable experiences (e.g., homepage, search, navigation) that millions of users rely on daily.

Your mission will be to establish a quality-first culture in one of the most critical product areas of Superbet - ensuring that we can release confidently, move fast, and maintain exceptional reliability.

You’ll build automated test coverage for business-critical scenarios, implement quality gates and monitoring pipelines, and help define how the entire Explore tribe ships with speed and confidence.

What you’ll do
  • Design and implement test automation frameworks that scale across multiple applications and services.
  • Design and implement comprehensive test automation solutions that encompass web applications, web services (microservices), and native apps. Ensure coverage across various testing types, including UI testing, API testing, and others, to support robust quality assurance practices
  • Collaborate with engineers, PMs, and designers to shift quality left - catching defects early and embedding quality in our CI/CD pipelines.
  • Build synthetic monitoring and alerting for key user journeys (homepage load, personalization logic, etc.).
  • Define quality metrics (e.g., release health, flakiness, regression detection) and use them to drive continuous improvement.
  • Coach other engineers on test strategy, frameworks, and debugging best practices.
Why this role matters
  • The Homepage is one of Superbet’s highest-traffic and highest-revenue surfaces. Quality here impacts millions of sessions per day.
  • You’ll be part of a culture that values experimentation, fast iteration, and engineering excellence - not bureaucracy or QA bottlenecks.
Signals we’re screening for
  • 5+ years of experience as a QA Engineer, SDET, or Software Engineer with a strong focus on automation and quality at scale.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript for frontend automation, and familiarity with at least one backend language to validate API and service integrations.
  • Proven experience building frontend automation frameworks (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, etc.) and executing end-to-end automation coverage across web and mobile.
  • Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines and using observability tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Grafana, Datadog, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of non-functional testing - including load, performance, and reliability checks.
  • Clear communication, curiosity, and collaboration across design, product, and engineering.
  • High proficiency in written and spoken English.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Bonus points
  • Experience designing or scaling automation in event-driven architectures (Kafka, AWS, Docker, etc.), ideally in a product environment.
  • Strong understanding of backend integration testing — REST/GraphQL APIs, contract validation, and data consistency across systems.
  • Hands‑on experience with BDD (Behavior‑Driven Development) and related frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Xray or similar test management tools for tracking automation coverage and traceability.
About Us

We are a global technology company dedicated to building the future of entertainment and fan‑centric experiences.

With commercial markets in Brazil, Belgium, Poland, Romania, and Serbia, our company has evolved from a leading sports betting and gaming operator into a diversified product and tech organization, gathering more than 5,000 dedicated people across our teams.

Shaping the future of play

At Super, we are creating a unique entertainment ecosystem engaging millions of customers worldwide. Our product and technology teams in Amsterdam (the Netherlands), Madrid (Spain), Zagreb (Croatia), London (UK), and Bucharest (Romania) are building the playstack that will champion the future of play.

Our ambitious growth strategy

Our ambitious growth strategy focuses on expanding across Europe and Latin America while delivering immersive customer experiences and creating lasting value for our customers, partners, and communities.

Global recognition and standards

The company’s long‑term strategy is supported by world‑class investors. In 2019, Blackstone, the world’s largest alternative asset manager, made a strategic minority investment of €175 million. In 2025, we strengthened our financial position through a €1.3 billion refinancing agreement, reinforcing our partnership with Blackstone and enabling accelerated global expansion.

Super is committed to the highest standards of compliance, safety, and responsibility. As such, we are active members of the International Betting Integrity Association (IBIA) and the European Gaming & Betting Association (EGBA).

description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission‑critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI‑powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well‑being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

The Role

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world. There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day‑to‑day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career. Your future at Kyndryl Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands‑on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms.

Who You Are

Você é bom no que faz e possui a experiência necessária para comprovar isso. No entanto, tão importante quanto isso é o seu mindset de crescimento : alguém motivado a impulsionar o próprio desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional. Você é focado no cliente — alguém que prioriza o sucesso do cliente em seu trabalho. E, por fim, você é aberto e sem fronteiras — naturalmente inclusivo na forma como trabalha com os outros. Se quiser, posso adaptar o tom (mais formal, mais corporativo, ou mais próximo de uma descrição de vaga/perfil profissional).

Requisitos Técnicos / Soft Skills

Experiência com Arquitetura e Inovação para SAP/Cloud, FinOps, observability, GitHub Actions, integração ITSM KD com SNOW cliente, integrações Web, API Gateway, automação, IA, pipelines DevOps, SAST/DAST.

Principais atribuições
  • Definir e evoluir arquiteturas SAP e Cloud, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, resiliência e aderência às boas práticas de mercado.
  • Atuar na arquitetura de soluções híbridas e cloud‑native, integrando SAP com plataformas cloud, serviços web e APIs.
  • Liderar iniciativas de inovação tecnológica, avaliando e aplicando novas soluções em automação, IA e observability para melhoria contínua do ambiente.
  • Implementar e governar práticas de FinOps, com foco em otimização de custos, visibilidade de consumo e eficiência financeira em ambientes cloud.
  • Projetar e manter soluções de observability, incluindo monitoramento, logging e tracing, garantindo alta disponibilidade e rápida identificação de incidentes.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines DevOps, utilizando GitHub Actions para CI/CD, automação de deploys e padronização de processos.
  • Atuar na integração entre ITSM Kyndryl (KD) e ServiceNow do cliente, assegurando fluxo adequado de incidentes, mudanças, problemas e requisições.
  • Projetar e implementar integrações web e APIs, utilizando API Gateway para governança, segurança e performance das integrações.
  • Automatizar processos operacionais e de infraestrutura, reduzindo esforço manual e aumentando confiabilidade dos ambientes.
  • Incorporar práticas de segurança em DevOps (DevSecOps), incluindo integração de ferramentas SAST e DAST nos pipelines para análise contínua de vulnerabilidades.
Diferenciais

Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid‑friendly culture that supports your well‑being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in‑demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting‑edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands‑on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

title: CRO Manager
description:
About Us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer‑led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at:

About The Role

We are looking for a Conversion Rate Optimization Manager (CRO) to support the optimization of our reverse lookup products. This role is ideal for someone with a solid foundation in conversion rate optimization who wants to deepen their skills and grow alongside experienced growth leaders. In this role, you will work closely with the Senior Growth Manager to execute optimization cycles across multiple funnels. You’ll be involved in every stage of the CRO process – from research and hypothesis development to testing, analysis, and rollout – while focusing primarily on execution quality, organization, and learning. This is not a role for passive recommendations. You will actively contribute to experiments, ensure they are implemented correctly, and help turn insights into measurable improvements.

Key Responsibilities
  • Rollout, in collaboration with the Senior Growth Manager.
  • Assist with funnel analysis to identify friction points and optimization opportunities across multiple reverse lookup funnels.
  • Help translate hypotheses into clear experiment requirements and briefs for engineers.

title: Sr Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Description

Ria Money Transfer, a business segment of Euronet Worldwide, Inc. (NASDAQ: EEFT), delivers innovative financial services including fast, secure, and affordable global money transfers to millions of customers along with currency exchange, mobile top-up, bill payment and check cashing services, offering a reliable omnichannel experience. With over 600,000 locations in nearly 200 countries and territories, our purpose remains to open ways for a better everyday life.

We believe we can create a world in which people are empowered to build the life they dream of, no matter who they are or where they are. One customer, one family, one community at a time.

About This Role

We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning with a strong focus on MLOps to join our growing team. In this role, you'll own the end-to-end infrastructure and automation of ML pipelines, with a focus on deploying, scaling, monitoring, and maintaining real-time and batch machine learning workflows in production environments. This role collaborates closely with data scientists, IT, and platform teams to ensure ML models are production-ready, reliable, and observable at scale.

Roles & Responsibilities
  • Own, design, build, and maintain real-time and batch ML and pipelines supporting end-to-end ML lifecycle.
  • Develop infrastructure and tooling for continuous integration, testing, deployment, and retraining of ML models.
  • Implement and operate feature stores, model registries, and orchestration frameworks for reproducible ML workflows.
  • Deploy and serve ML models in low-latency and high-throughput production environments using containerized microservices.
  • Implement robust monitoring systems for Model Performance, Data quality, and Operation health.
  • Build automated alerting and dashboarding for visibility into ML system health.
  • Ensure model traceability, auditability, and governance practices.
  • Optimize infrastructure on cloud platforms (AWS) using Infrastructure as Code.
  • As part of our ML operation team, this role will be responsible to occasionally be on call over the weekends in the events of incidents.
Position Requirements
  • 5+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, MLOps Engineer, or related role.
  • Proficiency in Python and ML libraries (e.g., scikit-learn,…)
  • Experience with MLOps frameworks and tools
  • Strong understanding of containerization and deployment (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Proficiency with AWS and IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Experience with monitoring and observability stacks ( Grafana, CloudWatch, Opsgenie, Datadog).
  • Familiarity with streaming and batch data systems ( Spark, PySpark, Kenises).
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills; comfortable working cross-functionally.

  • Commuter Subsidy (only for those who go to the office)

O Nosso Jeito de Ser tem a # Saúde_e_Segurança como princípio. Para atrair e reter os melhores talentos, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios completo que contribuam para a qualidade de vida dos nossos funcionários e funcionárias:

  • Plano de academias e estúdios para atividade física (TotalPass)

Somos uma empresa de materiais de construção e soluções sustentáveis com mais de 13 mil empregados. Nossa trajetória começa em 1936, com a inauguração da nossa fábrica de Santa Helena, na cidade de Votorantim, no interior de São Paulo. Durante quase um século de existência, expandimos nossos negócios e mercados, cruzamos fronteiras e hoje somos uma das maiores empresas do setor no mundo. Atualmente, estamos presentes na América do Norte, América do Sul, Europa, Ásia e África. Somos uma empresa feita de gente que faz, que acredita, que constrói. Sempre juntos e com excelência para chegarmos cada vez mais longe, entregando resultados sustentáveis e ajudando a construir um mundo melhor para todos. E você pode fazer parte disso! Conheça nossas unidades de negócio:

A Engemix é a unidade de negócios de concreto da Votorantim Cimentos. Fundada em 1968, a Engemix firmou-se como referência em qualidade de concreto. Com mais de 40 centrais de concreto estrategicamente posicionadas em todo o território brasileiro, ao longo de sua trajetória a marca Engemix participou das principais obras do Brasil, como o Aeroporto de Guarulhos e a Ponte Estaiada, ambas no Estado de São Paulo; a Arena do Grêmio, localizada em Porto Alegre (RS); o Parque Eólico, em Aracati (CE); o Parque Olímpico, localizado no Rio de Janeiro (RJ); e a Arena Pernambuco, no Recife (PE). Mais informações no site: .

A Viter é unidade de insumos agrícolas da Votorantim Cimentos. A marca é líder em comercialização de calcário agrícola no Brasil e a única com presença nacional. Com o propósito de despertar e perpetuar o potencial máximo do solo, seus produtos têm origem garantida e a marca disponibiliza assistência técnica para análise e entendimento do solo. A Viter atua com cinco linhas de produtos: Calcário ITAÚ Fyller e convencional; Calfértil, que são óxidos de cálcio e magnésio; Optmix, mistura homogênea e industrializada de calcário e gesso; Sungard, protetor solar para folhas e frutos; e Granumax V, fertilizante granulado. Mais informações no site .

A Verdera é a unidade de gestão e destinação sustentável de resíduos da Votorantim Cimentos. Desde 1991, a empresa atua com coprocessamento e foi pioneira em trazer essa tecnologia para o Brasil. A Verdera atua na cadeia de soluções ambientais dando um novo valor para os resíduos. É um parceiro com alta capacidade de realização, que entende as particularidades de cada negócio e que está comprometido a fazer do jeito certo e a pensar de forma diferente para descobrir novas possibilidades que transformem a realidade de todos. Mais informações no site .
