description:
Como Senior Software Engineer, você será responsável por desenvolver, escalar e manter novas versões de um dos nossos produtos. Sua atuação será de Fullstack com foco principal e domínio na camada de Frontend, tendo autonomia e capacidade para assumir demandas de Backend sempre que necessário para garantir a entrega de ponta a ponta. Você trabalhará em parceria com equipes de desenvolvimento para criar designs detalhados de software e APIs, além de implementar melhorias contínuas para nossos clientes. A posição é 100% remota e reporta diretamente ao Team Lead de R&D, Francisco Aguiar.

Responsabilidades
  • Colaborar com arquitetos e gerentes de produtos para definir requisitos técnicos, focando na viabilidade e escalabilidade da solução ponta a ponta.
  • Projetar e manter uma arquitetura de frontend sólida, garantindo o reuso de componentes e a manutenibilidade do código.
  • Apoiar em demandas de sustentação, manutenção e desenvolvimento de serviços backend (Java), integrando mensageria (RabbitMQ) e modelando dados conforme a necessidade.
  • Definir e implementar contratos de APIs REST para garantir uma integração eficiente entre os sistemas.
  • Garantir a aplicação rigorosa de boas práticas de desenvolvimento, como SOLID, KISS e Clean Code.
  • Contribuir para a evolução técnica do time através de revisões de código e compartilhamento de boas práticas.
  • Criar desenhos de arquitetura técnica voltados para a interface e sua integração com o ecossistema de microsserviços.
Qualificações e Experiência Experiência
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software.
Tecnologias e Ferramentas
  • Conhecimento sólido em JavaScript (ES6+) e TypeScript.
  • Domínio de Vue.js, HTML5 e CSS3 (Sass/Less).

Terá impacto direto no crescimento da companhia com resultados ainda em 2025, podendo se tornar um importante canal de receita, com oportunidades claras de crescimento de carreira e potencial liderança com estruturação de um time especializado.

Sobre a Conta Azul

A Conta Azul é movida pela crença que todo empreendedor merece ter sucesso. Apesar do dia a dia cheio de responsabilidades, queremos que todo dono de um pequeno negócio consiga tempo para se dedicar ao que sempre sonhou quando decidiu abrir uma empresa. Por isso, usamos a tecnologia para criar uma plataforma em nuvem, onde o empreendedor juntamente com o seu contador, de forma simples e fácil, podem encontrar tudo o que precisam em tempo real. Buscamos pessoas motivadas neste propósito. Se você é esta pessoa, junte-se a nós!

Are you passionate about Cloud Security and Artificial Intelligence? Do you have a unique combination of deep technical knowledge, business acumen and strong interpersonal skills?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Security Solutions Architect to work with our largest customers. In this vital role, you will help overcome barriers to AWS adoption by identifying and tackling major security, risk, and compliance questions from stakeholders, as well as build and maintain CIO/CISO/CRO and executive-level relationships becoming their Security Advisor. You will work directly with customer security, audit, risk and compliance teams to help them understand how to confidently utilize AWS, identify risk and design controls, setup ongoing assurance, and establish automated compliance.

At AWS, customer obsession is in our DNA. The successful candidate will become a trusted advisor to customers and will work with AWS sales, business development, solutions architecture and product teams to help accelerate adoption by removing compliance and audit as barriers and suggest improvements to our services to meet the customer needs.

This position is based in São Paulo, Brazil, and the role requires approximately 15% travel (including international).

Key job responsibilities
  • Work with AWS customers to convey cloud computing security and risk management best practices
  • Work with other teams within AWS develop the internal security expertise and to drive revenue
  • Develop technical content, such as white papers, reference architectures, blogposts, workshops, or code samples that can be used by our customers to assist them in deploying secure cloud-based solutions
  • Assess security-related knowledge across AWS sales and solutions architecture teams and develop plans to address gaps
  • Presenting about security topics at AWS events, and represent AWS at security conferences by delivering presentations and lectures
About the team

The Security, Networking and Compliance team is a team of specialists distributed in the main LATAM cities that handles the expert-level customer requirements that are too complex for generalist solutions architects to handle.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

  • Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications
  • Experience architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc.
  • 5+ years of experience in the design and implementation of complex IT systems
  • 5+ years of experience in an information security or compliance role
  • AI Security Skills with demonstrated experience securing solutions leveraging IA.
  • Proven experience in customer-facing, sales-aligned roles such as consultant, solutions engineer, or solutions architect, with a demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally across multiple business units to drive and achieve results.
  • Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish
  • A background working in a highly regulated industry such as financial services (such as PCI‑DSS), healthcare or defense, and local regulations such as General Data Protection Law (LGPD)

Ficamos felizes pelo seu interesse em participar da nossa equipe de colaboradores, que já soma aproximadamente 5.500 funcionários.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de

serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

*A Santa Casa da Bahia NÃO solicita valores para nenhuma situação que envolva oportunidade de emprego, tampouco solicita PIX para realização de cursos para vagas de emprego ou envio de dados pessoais por mensagens. Nosso único meio para recebimento de currículos é através da plataforma Gupy, assim como todas as etapas do processo admissional, ambas situações acessadas com login e senha cadastrados pelo próprio usuário, enquanto cliente da plataforma.*

description:
Sr. Manager, Hardware Engineering at Nextracker Inc.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Hardware Engineering will serve as a hands‑on technical leader responsible for driving the design, development, and validation of advanced electronic systems that power Nextracker’s solar platform.

Job Description

This is a hands‑on leadership role combining deep technical expertise in power and control electronics, communication interfaces, high‑speed circuit design, and battery systems with the ability to manage and mentor a high‑performing electrical engineering team. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast‑paced environment, balancing strategic direction with direct design involvement, prototype testing, and cross‑functional collaboration.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead and contribute directly to the design, development, and testing of advanced electrical hardware for solar tracker and energy management products.
  • Manage and mentor a small team of electrical and mechanical engineers, fostering technical excellence, innovation, and professional growth.
  • Provide hands‑on technical leadership, including schematic design, simulation, PCB layout review, and prototype validation.
  • Oversee subsystem design for power conversion, control, communications, and high‑speed circuitry.
  • Guide development of battery‑related electronics, including battery management system (BMS) integration and protection circuits.

At R2, we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society. Small and medium businesses (SMBs) make up over 90% of companies in Latin America, yet they face a trillion-dollar credit gap. Our mission is to unlock SMBs’ potential by providing financial solutions that are tailored to their needs. We are reimagining the financial infrastructure of Latin America - where SMBs financial needs are satisfied without ever having to go to a bank.

We are now hiring a Chief of Staff to the CEO to drive flawless execution of key initiatives between R2 and Ant International in R2’s current growth inflection point. The Chief of Staff will serve as a strategic thought partner and execution leader for the CEO. This role is responsible for driving R2’s synergy workstreams with Ant, special projects, organizational effectiveness, planning cycles, and CEO-level prioritization.

title: Broker – Soy & SBM (São Paulo)
description:
Soy & Soybean Meal. Global Flows. Real Commercial Impact.

Already plugged into Brazil’s Soy/SBM flows? Bring your experience, relationships, and timing – and help strengthen CM’s footprint in one of the world’s most essential export hubs.

Why This Role Exists

We’re not hiring because we need “someone.”
We’re hiring because if we find the right experienced commercial broker, we will gladly make room … also because the market has more room, more flow, and more opportunity than the team can cover today.

Copenhagen Merchants has been growing in Brazil since opening our São Paulo office in 2022 – today home to four brokers, an execution specialist and an analyst. And we want to take the next step within Soy/SBM, strengthening our global origination–destination network stretching from South America to the Black Sea, EU, MENA, and Asia.

This is a role for someone who can walk in and start creating traction from day one – commercially, relationally, and structurally.

What You’ll Be Doing

You already know what real brokerage looks like – but here’s how it plays out with us:

  • Drive Soy/SBM brokerage across Brazil, South America, and global demand regions
  • Close deals and create value through timing, insight, and relationships
  • Connect daily with charterers, traders, crushers, and distributors – both local and global
  • Leverage CM’s global network (Geneva, Hamburg, Copenhagen, Barcelona, Dubai, Kaunas, etc.)
  • Share updates, pricing, and intel that feed directly into our unique market intelligence platform CM Navigator
  • Work hand-in-hand with local execution and the broader CM freight desks
  • Spot opportunities between origins, flows, and arbitrage – and act fast
  • Be part of a team that aims high but stays collaborative and human

This is senior-level brokerage: desk ownership, accountability, and impact.

Why CM

Before we talk culture, here’s the simple truth: CM gives you more levers to pull than almost any pure brokerage house out there.

At CM, you step into a value chain you won’t find in many brokerage houses:
brokers, freight, terminals, logistics, and digital market intelligence - all connected in one commercial ecosystem.

In São Paulo, you’ll join a small, skilled, and tight-knit team working close to both the market and the decisions. We move fast, keep things flat, and operate with integrity. No micromanagement. No politics. Just strong people doing good business together.

Who You Are

You’re an experienced broker or trader with deep roots in Soy/SBM – ideally across both origination and export flows. Not theoretical knowledge. Real relationships, real deal-history, real intuition.

We imagine you bring:

  • Strong experience in Soy/SBM brokerage or trading
  • A live network of counterparties across the Brazilian and Argentinian market – and beyond
  • A steady hand in volatile markets
  • The ability to operate independently while staying connected to a team
  • Solid commercial instincts + the discipline to follow through
  • Fluency in English; Portuguese required; Spanish a plus
  • A personality that fits our culture: curious, direct, collaborative, human

Above all, you know that brokerage is about trust, timing, and being the one people call first.

What We Offer
  • A role without artificial limits – if you can grow business, we’ll grow with you
  • A highly international setup with deep reach into all major grain flows
  • A nice and centrally located São Paulo office with strong colleagues, low hierarchy, and fast decisions
  • Access to CM Navigator and a global intelligence ecosystem
  • A family-owned group with a long-term mindset and a culture that values people as much as performance>
  • Freedom with accountability – and support when you need it

We don’t micromanage. We don’t do politics. We do markets, relationships, timing – and results.

Interested?

If this feels like the right team and the right platform for your next chapter, we’d love to hear from you – even if your CV isn’t polished.

Apply by uploading your CV, record a short video (max. 60 seconds) if you dare or simply reach out directly for a confidential conversation.

For questions, contact:
Augusto Abati – Hub lead for CM São Paulo or Simon Bach – Organization & People.

title: AJU- Operador de Equipamentos
description:
Job description

Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! ️

Adnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.

Globalmente, adnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.

O Operador de Equipamentos ficará responsável por realizar a operação de atendimento de rampa (movimentação de equipamentos motorizados ou não, embarque e desembarque de passageiros cadeirantes, transporte de bagagens e cargas entre as áreas operacionais do aeroporto) em aeronaves com segurança, qualidade e pontualidade, garantindo eficiência no processo e colaborando para a construção da percepção do cliente quanto aos serviços prestados pela empresa no que tange ao transporte de bagagens, cargas e pontualidade dos voos.

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto de Aracaju (AJU)!

Main responsibilities
  • Operar os equipamentos de rampa, realizando a movimentação segura de equipamentos rebocáveis no que tange a logística de preparação de box para atendimento dos voos com equipamentos necessários de acordo com a disponibilidade, levando-se em consideração o load fator, turnaroud da aeronave, distribuição de cargas e bagagens nos porões;
  • Disponibilizar os equipamentos de GPU, ACU e LPU sempre que a aeronave estiver com APU inoperante e/ou para a execução do projeto smart fuel;
  • Realizar o transporte de bagagem e cargas entre variadas áreas de cada aeroporto que estão embarcando, desembarcando ou em conexão;
  • Garantir a segurança de todos durante o atendimento operacional;
  • Garantir a transferência das bagagens de conexão imediata (HOT), para as outas aeronaves;
  • Recolher os equipamentos do box após o termino do atendimento.


Requirements and skills
  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) tipo D/E .
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento em processo de atendimento ao cliente;

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico, locomoção e deambulação para desenvolvimento das tarefas.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução dos veículos (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro) e percepção auditiva para detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.
